goal: Production-ready, product-neutral infrastructure MCP services plus a reference employee-entry orchestration.

standard_read_only.backend_connection: explicit least-privilege read-only identity or authorization proxy
standard_read_only.startup_policy: fail closed when read-only backend mode cannot be asserted
standard_read_only.tool_surface: typed explicit operation allowlist; no arbitrary URL, method, query, command, script or provider call
standard_read_only.audit: actor, reason/source and correlation ID; result payloads and credentials excluded from audit metadata

agent_optimized_diagnostics.pagination: bounded opaque cursors where upstream supports stable pagination
agent_optimized_diagnostics.sampling: deterministic bounded sampling after raw-cost accounting
agent_optimized_diagnostics.rate_limits: per-connector start-rate limit plus upstream rate-limit handling
agent_optimized_diagnostics.timeouts: per-request limit clipped by one monotonic per-tool total deadline
agent_optimized_diagnostics.cache_hints: product-neutral max-age hints that never weaken authorization
agent_optimized_diagnostics.server_load_protection: reject over-broad work before dispatch and reject oversized streamed responses before parsing

required_controls: approval bound to exact target and desired state

bounded read-only REST/API connector with pagination rate limits and cache hints
fixed Windows-native probe allowlist with bounded structured output and no arbitrary PowerShell
inventory health and relationship graph normalized before detail fan-out
